chapter.verse: Tua ahih manin vantung sapkhiatna ah a kihel, no a siangtho sanggamte aw, umin i pulak ahi, sawltak leh siampi lianpenpa ahi Jesu, limtak lungngai dih un.
Pasian' innpi sung bup ah Moses ciamkip ahih mah bangin Jesu zong amah siampi nasep a guanpa' tungah ciamkip hi.
Tua hi a, innlampa in ama' lam inn sangin minpha a sangzaw a ngah bangin Jesu zong Moses sangin minpha a sangzaw ngah dingin kilawm hi.
A hang pen inn a kici khempeuh mi khatpeuh ii lam hi a, ahi zongin na khempeuh a lam pen Pasian ahi hi.
Tu-in Moses pen nasem khat ahihna tawh Pasian' inn sung bup ah ciamkip a, a nung cianga kigenkhia ding thute gencian hi.
Khris ahihleh tapa khat ahihna tawh Pasian' inn sungah ciamkip hi. I lungmuanna leh i kisialhpih ahi i lametna thu i letkip takpi leh eite pen Pasian' innpi i hi hi.
Tua hangin Kha Siangtho in hih bangin gen hi: “Tuni-in ama' awging na zak uhleh
gamgawtak lak zia-etna hun sunga na lehdo lai uh danin na lungsim uh khauhsak kei un.
Na pupite un sittelna tawh kei hong zia-et uh a, keima' sepnate kum sawmli sung mu uh hi.
Tua hangin tua khangmite' tungah ka hehsuak a, ‘Hih mite a lungsim uh vakthap nilohin keima' lampite thei nailo uh hi,’ ka ci hi.
Hehna tawh ka kiciam mah bangin, ‘Amaute keima' tawldamna sung lutkha lo ding uh hi.’ ”
Sanggamte aw, a nungta Pasian' kiangpan a pialkhia zah dong dingin note' lakah lungsim a gilo, a umlah na om loh nadingun kidawm un.
Mawhna' hong khemna hangin note' lakah lungsim khauh kuamah na om loh nadingun “tuni,” a kicih laisiah nisimin khatlekhat kihanthawn un.
Sunglam kimuanna i ngah masak pen mah a tawp dongin i letkip takpi nakleh eite pen Khris sungah a pangkhawmte i suak hi.
Tua hi a, hih bangin kici hi: “Tuni-in ama' awging na zak uhleh na lehdo lai uh-a danin na lungsim uh khauhsak kei un.”
A hang pen za napi a lehdo teitei kuate ahi hiam? Moses' makaihna tawh Egypt pan a paikhia teng khempeuh hilo ahi hiam?
Tua hi a, kum sawmli sung kua' tungah Pasian a hehsuak ahi hiam? Mawhna a bawlte, gamgawtak lakah a misiluang uh a puk zihziahte hilo ahi hiam?
A thumanglo mite' tung losiah kua' tungah ama' tawldamna sung lutkha lo ding ci-in kiciam ahi hiam?
Tua hi a, amaute pen a muanlahna uh huhau-in a lut zolo ahihlam i thei hi.
